Bhagavad Gita, Chapter 2, Verse 21

“Partha, one who knows this as indestructible, eternal, unborn, and unchanging — how can such a person kill anyone, or cause anyone to be killed?”

The question is left open rather than answered. Krishna is not granting permission to kill; he is saying the person who genuinely sees this will no longer recognize the act as Arjuna now does.
